contract: GET /api/users/:id/listening-sessions. A user may read their own listening sessions and an admin another user; preserve pagination, date filters, session fields and empty results; forbidden/missing users deny.
exceptions: Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.
Mapped tests cover selected denial or lower-level behavior only; successful endpoint payload/state and complete source/client variants need explicit owner-packet assertions.

invariants.contract: GET /api/users/:id/listening-sessions returns the user playback sessions newest updatedAt first, each with user {id, username}, and total, numPages, page and itemsPerPage (default 10).
itemsPerPage and page slice the list, numPages rounds up, a page past the end is an empty array, and a user without sessions has total 0 and numPages 0.
401 unauthenticated; 404 unknown id for an admin; a non-admin gets 403 for other ids but 200 for its own id (the handler has no admin check).
